newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury 3-,6-mo bills seen at 5.03, 5.14/5 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury 3-,6-mo bills seen at 5.03, 5.14/5 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $28 billion in three- and six-month bills is expected to produce rates of 5.03 percent and 5.14/5.15 percent, respectively, dealers said on Monday.
"It's been very quiet here today and demand seems to be a little bit on the weak side," said a trader at a primary dealership.
In when-issued trading before the 1300 EST/1800 GMT bidding deadline, the three-month bills were at 5.03 percent while the six-month securities were at 5.145 percent.
